## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run gate` passes locally
- [ ] If it changes something on screen: run in `npm run dev` and describe what you clicked
- [ ] If it adds or updates a dependency: `npm run licenses` re-run and THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md committed

## Product rules (see CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] No model or weights are bundled or downloaded without the user asking
- [ ] No prompt or lyric text is changed without an accept step that shows the diff
- [ ] Deletes go to the OS trash
